verdict.rationale: Kick supports some open-format exports — a Tax Package Excel file with a full year-end financial package (kick-docs-9, kick-docs-20) and live spreadsheet sync of reports into Google Sheets (kick-supp-sheets-ai, kick-docs-21) — but there is no documented mechanism for exporting the full underlying ledger (all transactions, journal entries, chart of accounts, audit trail) in an open format for a clean migration off the platform. Missing for 10: full transaction/journal-entry export, a documented data-portability/exit workflow, and evidence of exporting beyond reports/tax package.
